name: Priya & Rahul
text: Saved us over ₹25,000 on paper invitation cards and all our friends loved the background music on WhatsApp!

name: Sneha & Ankit
text: Created our wedding invite in literally 2 minutes. The 1-tap Google Maps navigation saved our guests so much trouble!

name: Divya & Vikram
text: The UPI Shagun QR code is super convenient — elderly relatives sent their blessings directly without any hassle!

name: Kavya & Karthik
text: Loved the Tamil language support! My grandparents could read the entire invitation in Tamil effortlessly.

name: Meera & Aditya
text: The Jaipur Palace Arch cover theme matched our palace wedding venue so beautifully. Extremely elegant!

name: Pooja & Rohan
text: Editing event timings after booking was completely free and instant. No reprint stress at all!

name: Ananya & Varun
text: Sent our custom link to 400+ WhatsApp contacts in one afternoon. Fast, eco-friendly, and very budget-friendly.

name: Ritu & Saurabh
text: The AI love story generator wrote our meeting story so romantically! Everyone complimented us on the invite.

name: Shreya & Ishaan
text: Super smooth on mobile phones. Best ₹999 we spent on our wedding planning!

name: Aarti & Manish
text: The live guestbook blessing wall is so wholesome. Reading our friends' love notes made our week.

name: Neha & Siddharth
text: Beautiful animated cover themes and zero company ads. Looks like a custom ₹30,000 designer website!

name: Deepika & Tanmay
text: Loved being able to update our Google Drive photo album link after the wedding for all guests to view!
